notes.title: Hotfix 1.02
notes.content:
We had reports of an achievement bug which has now been fixed.

If you completed the game it should unlock automatically in the main menu. Otherwise it'll either unlock at the correct point, or when you complete the game if you already past it.

Thanks!

tags.bug: We had reports of an achievement bug which has now been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Guys![/h1]

Firstly, I want to thank the people that took a chance and supported us!

We've just pushed the first patch which is available now. Addressing the most important issues.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Made changes to Harpers collision response, she'll no longer suddenly stop on hitting objects. This was causing her to get stuck on corners and props. This change makes the controls feel much smoother and far less clunky.
[*]Fixed a bug where the reverb system could potentially cause crackly audio when Alt+Tabbing.
[*]Added a quit button, this one shouldn't have been necessary, it slipped us, we're really sorry about that.
[*]Fixed a potential bug in the Visitor Center that would cause Jack to stop speaking and halt progress, requiring a restart.
[*]Generic optimizations to world geometry, including draw distance optimization where appropriate and new LOD's.
[/list]

We'll be keeping an eye on the discussion board for any other big issues that need resolving!

We'll also think about how we can engage people earlier on, it's come to our attention a lot of people are being turned off early due to the slow start.

Thanks,

Nathan
